children: Mumbai-based Alkem Laboratories’ Chief Financial Officer (CFO) has resigned from his post to pursue new professional opportunities, according to a company filing with the stock exchanges.
The company said the CFO tendered his resignation on 30 July and will cease to hold any senior management position from September.

The executive has spent more than two years at Alkem Laboratories and previously served as CFO of Sahajanand Medical Technologies. Before joining the cardiac stent company, he had held senior finance roles at Alkem Laboratories and domestic pharmaceutical company Cipla.

In his resignation letter addressed to the company’s chairman, the CFO said he was thankful to the Board of Directors for entrusting him with strategic mandates, including building the MedTech business, the acquisition of Adroit, the creation of Alkem Wellness and the acquisition of Occlutech.
He said the decision to step down was not easy but added that he had chosen to pursue professional opportunities aligned with his long-term professional and personal growth.

The CFO’s resignation marks the second senior-level departure from Alkem Laboratories in less than six months, following the exit of former Chief Executive Officer Vikas Gupta. Gupta later joined ChrysCapital’s latest pharmaceutical buyout, Novartis India Limited.

During Alkem Laboratories’ Q1 FY27 earnings call, the management told analysts that it was in the process of identifying a successor and was likely to announce the appointment of a new CEO by the next quarter.
Following the announcement, shares of Alkem Laboratories closed 1.5 per cent lower at Rs 5,330 apiece on the BSE, compared with the previous close.
